current_status.final_resting_site: Ares Vallis, within 10m of Carl Sagan Memorial Station
current_status.cause_of_end: Pathfinder lander battery depletion and communications loss
current_status.historic_feat: First wheeled robotic roving vehicle successfully operated on Mars

traverse_summary.target_destination: Catastrophic outflow flood boulder plain of Ares Vallis
key_milestones: Deployment of microrover down deployment ramps (Sol 2)
APXS elemental interrogation of rock 'Barnacle Bill' (Sol 3)
Analysis of 'Yogi' rock and andesitic compositions (Sol 8)
Circumnavigation of lander platform and soil mechanical tests (Sol 60-83)

waypoints.activity: Lander touchdown inside catastrophic flood plain
First Alpha Proton X-ray Spectrometer (APXS) measurement of an alien rock; discovered high silicon content (andesite)
APXS contact measurement on large basalt boulder perched on outflow sediment
waypoints.hazard_warning: Rock collision risk during contact placement

waypoints.activity: Soil trenching experiment with left middle wheel
Mission ended after lander battery failure terminated carrier downlink
